messages.plaintextBody:
Sarah,

On the Crossfield matter, I've remembered a detail for my witness statement: the grade-430 substitution was raised verbally at the August production meeting before it appeared in any paperwork. Thought it might be relevant to the 316L point. Can we add it?

Henry Doyle
Operations Director, Pennington Industries
